name: Temporal Distortion
description: Words fall slower for 8 seconds. Each cast adds its own slow: two at once are slower still.

name: Frostbinding
description: Freezes every word in place, and stops new words appearing, for 5 seconds. Each extra cast adds 5 more. You can keep typing.

name: Arcane Shield
description: The next 2 words that reach the ward line do no harm. Each cast adds 2 more. Lasts until the end of the level.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Strikes the lowest word and arcs to the 3 words nearest it. They score and count toward the level.

name: Transmutation
description: Every word of 6 or more letters becomes a short word of 3–4 letters.

name: Incineration
description: A last resort: burns every word on the field. Burned words give no points and don't count toward the level.

name: Arcane Purge
description: Restores the wards: instability back to 0% (Hardcore: halves it), and every word loses the extra speed your mistakes gave it.

name: Harvest
description: Claims every word on the field: they all count toward the level, at half points.
